known_structural_hazards.title: Combine Drill Opt-Out Missingness (Selection Bias)
known_structural_hazards.description: Prospects frequently opt out of specific Combine drills (e.g., 3-cone, short shuttle, or 40-yard dash) due to training strategy, minor injury, or high projected draft status. Missingness in Combine drills is Missing Not At Random (MNAR).
known_structural_hazards.mitigation: Never use naive mean imputation on Combine drill times; model drill participation indicators explicitly or evaluate within drill-complete sub-cohorts.

known_structural_hazards.title: Unsigned Acceleration (`a`) vs. Signed Tangential Deceleration (`ds/dt`)
known_structural_hazards.description: In Next Gen Stats 10 Hz tracking files, column `a` represents the non-negative scalar magnitude of the acceleration vector (`a >= 0`). Treating high `a` during braking phases as positive forward acceleration corrupts burst vs. deceleration analyses.
known_structural_hazards.mitigation: Derive signed tangential acceleration/deceleration via finite differences of speed (`ds/dt`) or by projecting the acceleration vector onto the motion direction vector (`dir`).

known_structural_hazards.title: Circular Angle Discontinuity at 0° / 360° Boundary (`o` and `dir`)
known_structural_hazards.description: Orientation (`o`) and direction (`dir`) are recorded in degrees modulo 360. A 2-degree rotation from 359° to 1° produces a naive arithmetic difference of -358°.
known_structural_hazards.mitigation: Always compute angular differences using circular unwrapping: `atan2(sin(θ2 - θ1), cos(θ2 - θ1))`.

known_structural_hazards.title: Play Direction (`left` vs. `right`) Coordinate Inversion
known_structural_hazards.description: Raw stadium coordinates `x` (0–120) and `y` (0–53.3) depend on which endzone the offense is attacking (`playDirection`).
known_structural_hazards.mitigation: Standardize all plays to move left-to-right (`x_std = 120 - x`, `y_std = 53.3 - y`, `o_std = (o + 180) % 360`, `dir_std = (dir + 180) % 360` when `playDirection == 'left'`).

known_structural_hazards.title: Frame-Level Many-to-Many Join Explosion
known_structural_hazards.description: Joining `combine_tracking.csv` directly to `game_tracking_YYYY.csv` on `nflId`, or joining on `playId` without `gameId`, multiplies rows by thousands per player.
known_structural_hazards.mitigation: Aggregate frame-level tables to player-drill or player-play summaries prior to cross-domain joins.
